title: Herbaceous Mediterranean Falafel Flatbread
description: A fluffy, herb-packed flatbread topped with homemade falafel and tahini sauce, perfect for a romantic date night in the Mediterranean style.
instructions: Combine chickpeas, garlic, onion, parsley, cumin, salt, pepper and a splash of water in a food processor until a coarse paste forms.
Shape the chickpea mixture into small balls and bake on parchment for 20 minutes, flipping halfway.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and a pinch of salt; add warm water and olive oil, then knead into a smooth dough.
Divide dough into 6 portions, roll each into a thin circle, and brush with a little olive oil.
Cook dough circles on a hot skillet for 2 minutes per side until lightly browned.
Assemble each flatbread by placing a spoonful of falafel, a drizzle of tahini sauce, and extra parsley on top.
Return assembled flatbread to the oven for 5 minutes to meld flavors.
Slice and serve warm with a side of mixed greens.
